newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Olympic Financial a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Olympic Financial a buy.

text.p: -- Montgomery Securities said its analyst Joe Jolson raised his rating on Olympic Financial Ltd to buy from hold based on a recent decision by the company's board to pursue an unsolicited takeover offer.
-- Jolson said he thought the most likely buyer is a retail-oriented commercial bank seeking to broaden its participation in the non-prime auto finance market.
-- Jolson sees an auction for the company taking place over the next four to six weeks.
